pages.title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
pages.text: A brass drum of numbered holes: each prime in turn knocks out its multiples, and what falls through is prime.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the sieve's limit N and how many small primes its wheel skips. About N / ln N primes come out, and a recipe needs a number of them; the work grows as N ln ln N, and a bigger wheel cuts it.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Prime Shard.
